# Sensilchem

> Longyan Shenghe Trading Co., Ltd — professional manufacturer and exporter of
> precipitated silica, fumed silica and SILSEP® feed additives, operating under
> the CENSIL® and Sensilchem® brands from Longyan, Fujian, China since 2009.

Sensilchem supplies amorphous precipitated silica (powder, micropearl and
granular), fumed silica (hydrophilic and hydrophobic), specialty silica grades
for feed, battery separators and beer brewing, plus the SILSEP® integrated feed
additive system for feed safety and animal health. Direct factory supply with
OEM/ODM and custom synthesis; free samples available for evaluation.

## Key facts

- Legal entity: Longyan Shenghe Trading Co., Ltd (龙岩市晟合贸易有限公司)
- Founded: 2009 · Base: Longyan City, Fujian, China
- Brands: CENSIL® (silica), Sensilchem® (chemical solutions), SILSEP® (feed additives)
- Certifications held: FAMI-QS, SGS, ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001:2004
- ICP filing: 闽ICP备19019250号-1
- Website: https://sensilchem.com
- Alibaba store: https://www.alibaba.com/supplier/longyan-shenghe-trading.html

## Product range

### Precipitated silica — rubber grade
- Molecular formula SiO₂·nH₂O; supplied as powder, micropearl and granular
- For tires, belts, seals, rubber and plastics reinforcement
- Packing: 15 kg / 20 kg PP woven bag, 25 kg paper valve bag

### Precipitated silica — powder grade (feed, anti-caking, carrier)
- Grades: CENSIL 260PA, 260PB, 260PC, 270P, 280P, 38A, 1000P
- SiO₂ (dry basis) ≥ 98%; heating loss (105 °C, 1.5 h) ≤ 6.5%
- Ignition loss (1000 °C, dry basis) ≤ 7.0%; pH (5% suspension) 6.0–7.0
- BET surface area 160–195 m²/g (CENSIL 38A: 195–250 m²/g)

### Precipitated silica — micropearl grade
- Good fluidity, high porosity, strong absorbability; anti-caking agent
- Packing: 15 kg / 20 kg PP woven bag, 300–790 kg jumbo bag

### Fumed silica
- White colloidal micro-particle, primary particle size 5–40 nm
- Thixotropy, reinforcing, thickening and filling
- Hydrophilic and surface-treated hydrophobic types
- For coatings, adhesives and sealants

### Specialty silica
- Battery separator grade — porous structure for PE separators
- CENSIL 320 — silica gel for beer brewing, removes haze-forming proteins
- Matting agent grade — flatting agent for matte and satin finishes

### SILSEP® feed additives
- Mold Guard — binds mycotoxins (aflatoxins, DON) and inhibits mold growth
- Immunity — immune activation plus probiotic barrier and microbiome support
- Intestinal Health — probiotics, prebiotics, organic acids, functional peptides
- Digestive — enzymes, bile acids and probiotics for aquatic digestion
